headline: Piopiota Build
title: Piopiota Best Build | Surf and Surge | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Piopiota is a Water support. Run Surf, which rides a wave into the target and makes puddles, and Surge, a team heal that gets extra healing from nearby puddles. Fight on top of the puddles you make, and hold a Miraculous Fleece. To get one, evolve Popota at level thirty nine with an opposite gender Susuta following you. Do you run Piopiota? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Piopiota is a Water support. Run Surf and Surge, heal on top of your own puddles, hold a Miraculous Fleece and evolve Popota at level 39 with an opposite gender Susuta following.
